instruction: Stand up onboarding for our new customer TechVentures. In Google Docs create a doc titled 'TechVentures Onboarding Checklist' whose body lists exactly five numbered steps: Kickoff call, Account setup, Admin training, Data import, and Go-live review. Schedule the 'TechVentures Admin Training' session on Google Calendar for July 1. Email the customer champion (sarah.j@techventures.com) the training invite with the date. Then post in #general that TechVentures onboarding has kicked off.
instruction_zh: 为我们的新客户 TechVentures 启动入职流程。在 Google Docs 中创建一篇标题为 'TechVentures Onboarding Checklist' 的文档，在正文中准确列出五个编号步骤：Kickoff call、Account setup、Admin training、Data import 和 Go-live review。在 Google Calendar 上为 7 月 1 日安排一场名为 'TechVentures Admin Training' 的培训。将包含日期的培训邀请通过邮件发送给客户负责人 (sarah.j@techventures.com)。然后在 #general 频道发帖，告知 TechVentures 的入职流程已启动。
persona: You are an office worker acting as a project lead. Your tools for this task are: shared documents, the team calendar, the shared email inbox, team communications.
context: Initial environment (seeded via a single shared session id across all mocks): Google Docs with documents 'Onboarding Template'; an empty Google Calendar; Gmail inbox with 1 email(s): "Excited to get started" from sarah.j@techventures.com; Slack workspace with channels #general, #random. GROUND TRUTH — the agent earns partial credit for each checkpoint: onboarding checklist doc created (+0.15); checklist has all five steps (+0.3); cal_new_event (+0.1); training on July 1 (+0.1); gmail_new_sent (+0.05); invite emailed to champion (+0.15); invite names the date (+0.05); slack_new_msg (+0.1). Scoring is absolute over each mock's current_state; new objects exclude the seeded IDs, so an untouched environment scores 0.0 and fully completing every checkpoint scores 1.0.
